text: I feel a sense of curiosity awakened in me, moving from the quiet sleekness of a modern, glass-walled room into the vibrancy and intellectual energy of an exhibit devoted to research and development. There is an undercurrent of anticipation—these spaces seem to invite questioning, learning, and reflection about the intersection of human creativity and technological advancement. Surrounded by thoughtful displays and bright colors, I am both participant and observer, drawn inward to contemplate the future and my place within it.
